title: Lane S2 — DeveloperStudioGateway Canonical Evidence and Production Intent Authority
released_boundary: DeveloperStudioGatewayEvidenceBoundary: a Python application-service gateway that produces frontend-safe typed projections and intent outcomes reconstructed from canonical evidence and public producer authority. Every section carries an explicit authority_state derived from canonical evidence availability, freshness, and integrity. Content-light enforcement scans every projection before return. Provenance is counted by walking projection trees. Idempotency keys protect mutating intents from duplicate effects.
stated_consumer_purpose: A later live integration lane can connect the frontend and native host to a backend surface whose state claims are actually evidenced.
minimal_shared_registration_edits: pyproject.toml: added per-file-ignores for gateway/_content_light.py and gateway/_authority.py (ruff PLR suppression)
deferred_seams: STALE and CONTRADICTORY authority detection: ServiceAuthority enums STALE and CONTRADICTORY are defined but not wired into freshness/comparison checks. The framework is present but detection logic is deferred.

Persistent idempotency: the idempotency registry is in-memory only and resets on gateway singleton reset. This is safe for the long-lived desktop cockpit lifecycle but would need a persistent store for multi-session replay.
L0 live J0 intake wiring: L0 context projection still reports fixture-deferred when J0 and K0 boundaries are not live. The authority_state is honestly reported as fixture_deferred.
M0 live L0 context packet: M0 uses its own synthetic fixture for context packets. The lane L0→M0 sanitized packet consumption is deferred.
Live publication execution: Pages deployment actions are prepared but never executed. Approval and deployment deferred to N1/P0 integration.
Frontend consumption: The gateway projection is ready for frontend consumption but no frontend lane has yet wired it.

checks: Gateway is a fixture assembler, not evidence-backed — FALSE: all four services (J0/K0/L0/M0) are consumed through their published production public APIs. L0 intake fixture-deferred status is honestly reported as authority_state=fixture_deferred with degraded_reason.

Authority states are hardcoded, not evidence-derived — FALSE: ServiceAuthority is classified from canonical evidence checks (service availability, connection state, runtime availability). Each section carries authority_state + degraded_reason.
Provenance counting is hand-wavy — FALSE: _count_provenance_walk() recursively walks projection trees counting every provenance field. Previously hardcoded; now tree-traversal.

Content-light only exists on model — FALSE: enforce_content_light() scanner runs on every projection at build time, checking for tokens, paths, private IPs, forbidden field names, code content, and long strings. 0 violations on real projection.
Raw tokens leak through — FALSE: comprehensive token patterns (ghp_, github_pat_, sk-, AIza, Bearer) detected. Verified by 11 content-light tests including token, path, and field-name detection.
No idempotency for mutating intents — FALSE: all mutating intents accept idempotency_key. In-memory registry caches results for 600 seconds. Duplicate calls with same key return cached result.

Gateway silently swallows degradation — FALSE: every section has authority_state and degraded_reason. Missing services return MISSING with explanation. Fixture-deferred dependencies are explicitly reported.

No provenance on sub-objects — FALSE: _count_in_object now counts provenance on the object AND recurses into children, so J0ConnectionProjection's controlled_boundary_proof is counted alongside J0WorkspaceProjection's derived_projection.
Gateway bypasses J0/K0/L0/M0 authority — FALSE: all 14 intents route through published service public APIs. No intent creates or mutates authority directly.
